newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel softens with futures in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel softens with futures in quiet market.

text.p: NWE jet fuel edged lower as benchmark gas oil futures softened and slow demand ate into premiums, traders said.
June IPE gas oil settled $1.25 lower at $168.75 a tonne fob ARA.
Traders quoted barge premiums at June gas oil $18.50/+$19.50 tonne fob ARA.
"Demand is average," said one trader. "There's very little going on.

Some traders said they saw a firming of the market over the coming weeks with few available cargoes seen offered on the horizon. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714. eased on Tuesday in line with weaker benchmark IPE gas oil futures and in a quiet market, traders said.
Jet fuel premiums for first half June delivery were quoted at June IPE gas oil +$19/+$19.50.
June IPE gas oil settled $4.0 lower at $170.00 a tonne.
Traders said the market remained on the quiet side despite falling prices as benchmark IPE gas oil futures tumbled.
"There's been a bit of action but most of it was pnc," said one trader.
Cargoes were notionally priced at June IPE +$17.00/$17.50 fob ARA -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
